admission.justification: A count-only bound on the repaired stores permits one large parsed or computed value to dominate their retained memory.

applicability: The repaired shared tool and reviewer memo paths that charge retained Python graphs.
conditions: An entry is weighed from its key and value and skipped when its own charge exceeds the retained-byte allowance. The active caller may still receive the computed result.
Insertion and least recently used eviction run under the same lock. Both aggregate limits hold when the insertion returns.
exclusions: Temporary allocations, unrelated observation memos with separate units, and the async run registry have separate ownership.

evidence: bug-r18-item-2-cache-census.md and the exact-small and oversized gate, view, and candidate-parse reuse tests.
handoff.path: BUG-L18 W2 affected knowledge and initial history

statement: Graph-charged tool-server and reviewer memos reject individually oversized entries and finish each insertion with the retained entries within both configured ceilings.
